<div class="card-body">
'''On The Edge''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">絶体絶命</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、能力値＞２の反乱軍の一人（場のカード）を選ぶ。１から６の中から数字を一つ選ぶ。引いた運命数＞選んだ数なら、ロストデッキから選んだ数と同じ枚数だけフォースを再使用できる。失敗したら、選んだ反乱軍はロストデッキへ。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-101o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークとレイアは、ストームトルーパーから逃れようとして、デス・スター中心部にかけられた収納された橋の終端から危うく落ちかけた。トルーパーの追撃がドアの向こうに迫る。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' On the edge.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force and choose one Rebel of ability > 2 on table. Choose a number from 1 to 6. If destiny > that number, retrieve that many Force from the Lost Pile. If you fail, that Rebel is lost.

'''Lore:''' Trying to escape stormtroopers, Luke and Leia nearly fell from the end of a retracted bridge in the Death Star core. Troopers close in beyond the door.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[On The Edge]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
